change: Bounded rounding adapter for Jev Choice API probabilities
reason: An observed seven-class response used hundredth-grid probabilities summing to 0.99; its labels, chosen maximum, model and usage were otherwise valid.
acceptance_requirements: Every class remains present exactly once.
Every probability remains finite and within [0,1].
A rounded vector must have a positive sum.
The chosen class must still be a highest-probability option.
Exact pinned model and valid confidence remain required.
normalization: Only accepted hundredth-grid vectors whose sum differs from 1 by more than 1e-5 are divided by their original sum.
raw_response_policy: Raw response bytes and returned raw API response JSON are not modified. parse_choice returns adapted analysis probabilities.
